# Toast UI Editor (vendored)

Version: **3.2.2**

Source: https://uicdn.toast.com/editor/3.2.2/

- `toastui-editor-all.min.js` — full browser build (`toastui.Editor`)
- `toastui-editor.min.css` — editor styles
- `theme/toastui-editor-dark.min.css` — dark theme

Used with `initialEditType: 'wysiwyg'`, `getMarkdown()` / `setMarkdown()`.
